title: Realistic stars
description: Adds realistic night sky to the minecraft
body:
The mod adds physically accurate night sky
![moon image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a0fe58cbfc022d780494f4ac06201dab8926aa61_0.webp)
Stars positions are taken from NASA csv [dataset](https://github.com/astronexus/HYG-Database).
